_about: Shown once on each phone after it installs a new Android update (not on a first install). Replace the list with what this update changes, in plain words, each time an Android update is approved and built.
items: With pallets from more than one DC, each row shows its DC, and the filters have a DC filter (All DCs, Vault, Rugby…).
In the dark, the camera scanner turns the torch on by itself. Tap Torch off if you don’t want it, or turn it off in Settings.
Changing an LPN in the log now checks it like a new one, and a note says if it doesn’t look right (Undo puts it back).
The Manifest check’s Excel now shows LOG ONLY and NO MANIFEST in full, without stretching the column.
A calmer look: orange for the main button on each screen, plainer Settings headings, clearer status icons, and Live read’s buttons now match the camera scanner.
